title: The tech backlash is now in theaters
hook_text: Aaron Sorkin frames Mark Zuckerberg as a robotic villain.
script:
Aaron Sorkin directs The Social Reckoning in 2026 to frame Mark Zuckerberg as a robotic villain.
Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim dropped features examining how Silicon Valley reshapes modern reality.
Cinemas are stacked with critical movies portraying disruptive tech founders as societal destabilizers.
Hollywood previously romanticized startup culture in films like The Social Network.
Audiences now get an aggressive cultural pushback against tech billionaires breaking public trust.
Would you watch a feature film about tech founders breaking society?
